description: An extension of accessory_addon_data used specifically for air horn accessories. Functions the same as accessory_addon_data, adding the sound_path attribute to bind a horn sound event to the accessory.
versionNote: This unit type was added in 1.38.

sound_path.description: Path to the sound bank/event or soundref used for the horn accessory.
sound_path.notes: Per the 1.38 modding guide, this can link either a .soundref file OR a direct sound bank event string ("bank_path#event_name") — since only one of those two forms is actually a file with an extension, expectedExtensions is left null rather than picking one.
